correctness.rationale: Assessment of /workspace/repairs/2/{RESULT.md,VERIFICATION.md,SLOGAN.txt}. The frozen Finding's 'exponentially thin normal layer' sentence is false as a thickness assertion: the exact conditional tail implies Pr(D_n≤a_n | D_n>0)≤(2n−2)a_n/h_n, tending to zero for a_n=o(1/n), including exponentially small thickness. The repair distinguishes exponentially small volume, n^(-1) depth and n^(-1/2) imbalance. For the corrected theorem, weighted Hall constraints reduce to the singleton inequalities (any two rows see all columns); at most one strict violation is possible. Orthogonal projection along the doubled centered coordinate normal preserves each block sum, nonnegativity follows from delta≤min(p_i,q_i), and each other paired sum stays ≤1−delta+delta/(n−1). Therefore it is the nearest point even at cell boundaries. On the cap the initially independent marginal deficits have joint density proportional to u^(n−2)v^(n−2) restricted to u+v<1 (they are no longer independent there). Jacobian S gives independent S and W with the displayed beta laws. Integrating the triangle gives one cap probability 1/binom(2n−2,n−1); the depth tail gives moments and the mean-zero tight frame of normalized doubled normals has operator Pi_{H+}/(n−1). Consequently the ambient covariance eigenvalues and null dimensions agree. Gamma CLT and the ratio map give sqrt(8n)(W−1/2) asymptotically standard normal, independently of (2n−2)(1−S); S→1 and the sign of 1−2W do not change the Gaussian assertion. A layer c_n/n for c_n→∞ captures asymptotically all conditional mass; a layer o(1/n) captures none. Independent exact replay python /workspace/branches/independent_math_1_4.py 2 checks all product points of the quarter grid at n=3,4,5, including the variational nearest-point inequality against every surviving vertex for cap points, and covariance entries at n=3..24. The frozen checker was inspected, not run. Its QPs start at the proposed projection, and the factorial checks independently test cap normalization but not moment denominators; the replacement scientific notes now state these limits.

value.rationale: For the natural crown metric–volume example, the surviving exact conditional joint law distinguishes the distribution of an interior point's normal error from its transverse imbalance and quantifies both with scales and a joint limit. Knowing only the apex gap and cut volume does not give that geometry. This is a useful exact description of typical points under the rare-event sampling law; it does not present the standard beta/gamma identities or cap homothety as independent research contributions.
